name: @merit/harness
description: DEP-M21-01. The Monte Carlo harness: a trial loop and an aggregator over packages/rithmic's day model, folded through the real rules engine, producing the RE-S-nn outputs against a candidate configuration. Every result carries its calibration identity and sample size.
//: IT DEPENDS ON THE ENGINE AND ON THE SIMULATOR AND NEITHER DEPENDS ON IT. RI-01 asserts packages/rules-engine declares no workspace dependency, so the arrow can only point this way; packages/rithmic is the vendor side and a vendor adapter that imported the rulebook would be a vendor adapter deciding a rule. Both resolve through their `exports` maps, which publish `.` and nothing else, so no file inside either package is reachable from here. SIMULATION_HARNESS section 4 is the reason that matters: the harness generates balances and reads outcomes, and a harness that could reach `rules-engine/src/day/breach.js` could decide one.
